translations.web: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not believe though it is told you.
translations.bsb: “Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
translations.kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told
translations.asv: Behold ye among the nations, and look, and wonder marvellously; for I am working a work in your days, which ye will not believe though it be told you.
